verdict.rationale: First-party docs directly state that ChatGPT can generate or edit images from requests. Editing is supported through reference images, transforming existing images "with a few simple words," and Canvas comments for precise feedback, with Focused and Canvas views for review. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of image generation and editing quality.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can generate and edit images from natural-language prompts

citations.quote: Ask ChatGPT to generate or edit images.
Generate original images from a description, or transform existing ones with a few simple words.
Add a reference image when you want ChatGPT to transform an existing asset or use it as visual guidance.
In Canvas view, use Comment to add precise feedback to one or more images.
